generate_table.Documentation: API endpoint that receives a number from the frontend, calculates its multiplication table (up to 10), and returns the table as a JSON response. Handles potential errors such as invalid input.

input.description: Input field for the user to enter a number.

button.description: Button to trigger the generation of the multiplication table.

table.description: Element where the multiplication table is displayed.

generateTable.Documentation: Function to send the number to backend and generate multiplication table dynamically.
